text.ms:
1. Mencuci, mencetak gambar, mengeluar slaid filem atau apa -apa bentuk
format atau kombinasi mana-mana aktiviti tersebut.

2. Mengukir, mencetak, melukis, menulis, mengukir timbul atau apa-apa aktiviti
lain seumpamanya pada barang bercukai dengan perihalan yang
berhubungan dengan rekod sukan atau hal keadaan lain barang bercukai itu
didermakan atau dianugerahkan.

4. Penyediaan makanan atau minuman oleh—

(i) mana-mana orang yang menyediakan perkhidmatan di bawah
Kumpulan B, Jadual Pertama, Peraturan -Peraturan Cukai
Perkhidmatan 2018 [P.U.(A) 214/2018]; atau

(ii) dapur berpusat untuk pengedaran ke premisnya yang menyediakan
perkhidmatan di bawah Kumpulan B, Jadual Pertama,
Peraturan-Peraturan Cukai Perkhidmatan 2018 [P.U.(A) 214/2018].

5. Penyediaan logam tar, penapisan tar, dan penyediaan campuran bitumen dan
logam panas untuk pembinaan jalan.

6. Pengeluaran salinan dokumen dengan mesin penyalin atau proses
penyalinan yang seumpamanya.

7. Pembungkusan semula barang pukal yang sama ke dalam bungkusan yang
lebih kecil.
8. Pembaikan barang terpakai atau barang yang telah digunakan.

9. Ujian penglihatan, preskripsi kanta yang sesuai dan pemasangan  kanta
tersebut ke dalam bingkai.

10. Operasi yang be rikut apabila dilakukan oleh seseorang selain daripada
pengilang berdaftar:

(i) memvarnis dan/atau menggilap kepingan perabot yang telah siap;

(ii) pemasangan kaca bahagian atas dan/atau pintu kaca ke perabot
selain yang siap.

11. Pengurangan saiz dan/atau perubahan bentuk tanpa menguba h sifat barang
bercukai tersebut.

12. Pemberian perkhidmatan jahitan secara peribadi tetapi tidak termasuk
perkhidmatan jahitan yang disediakan oleh syarikat yang terlibat dalam
perniagaan mengilang pakaian dan barang tekstil lain.

13. Mencetak, menjahit atau menampal logo, mengait, krusye atau menyulam
pada pakaian siap.

14. Pewarnaan kain yang dibekalkan oleh orang lain tanpa mengubah saiz atau
bentuk kain tersebut.

15. Pengilangan kain batik menggunakan teknik tradisional pencetakan blok
secara manual, pencetakan skrin secara manual dan/atau lukisan tangan atau
lukisan dan barang daripadanya.

16. Operasi membersih dengan membuang kotoran atau habuk tanpa apa -apa
operasi lain.".

Dibuat 29 Ogos 2022
[KE.HF(152) 899/04 JLD 2(7); MOF.TAX(S)700-1/2/26 JLD. 5; PN(PU2)751/JLD. 7]

    TENGKU DATUK SERI UTAMA ZAFRUL BIN TENGKU ABDUL AZIZ
                                        Menteri Kewangan

SALES TAX ACT 2018

SALES TAX (EXEMPTION FROM REGISTRATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powe rs conferred by subsection 20(1) of the
Sales Tax Act 2018 [Act 806], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation
1. This order may be cited as the Sales Tax  (Exemption from Registration)
(Amendment) Order 2022.

Amendment of paragraph 2
2. Sales Tax (Exemption from Registration)  Order 2018 [P.U. (A) 20 8/2018], which
is referred to as "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in paragraph 2—

(a) by substituting for subparagraph (1) the following subparagraph:

     "(1)   Any person who  operates only one manufacturing operation out
of several operation s in a manufac turing chain to produce a goods  and that
operation is specified in Schedule A, such person is exempted from registration
under subsection 13(1) of the Act irrespective of the total sale s value of the
taxable goods in the period of twelve months."; and

(b) by inserting after subparagraph (1) the following subparagraph:

    "(1A) Notwithstanding subparagraph (1), if the person operates more
than one manufacturing operation s as specified in Schedule A and such
manufacturing operations does not relates in producing a goods, the person is
exempted from registration.".

Amendment of Schedule A
3. Schedule A to the principal Order is amended  by substituting for Schedule A
the following schedule:

"SCHEDULE A

1. The developing, printing of photograph, production of film slides or any forms
or combination of any of those activities.

2. Engraving, printing, drawing, writing, emboss ing or any other similar
activities on taxable goods with a description relating to the sports record or
other circumstances under which the taxable goods was donated or awarded.

3. The manufacture of ready mixed concrete.

4. The preparation of foods or drinks by —

(i) any person who provide services under Group B, First Schedule,
Service Tax Regulations 2018 [P.U.(A) 214/2018]; or

(ii) central kitchen for distribution to its premises wh ich provide
services under Group B, First Schedule, Service Tax
Regulations 2018 [P.U.(A) 214/2018].

5. The preparation of tarred metal, tarred screening, and hot mixed
preparations of bitumen and metal for road construction.

6. The production of copies of documents by the copy machine or similar
copying process.

7. The repacking of the same bulk goods into smaller packages.

8. The repair of second hand or used goods.

9. The testing of eyesight, the prescription of suitable lenses and the installation
of such lenses into frames.

10. The following operations when performed by a person other than a registered
manufacturer:

(i) the varnishing and/or polishing of finished pieces of furniture;

(ii) the installation of glass tops and/or glass doors to pieces of
furniture otherwise complete.

11. The reduction of size and/or changing of the shape without changing  the
nature of such taxable goods.

12. The rendering of personal tailoring service b ut excluding tailoring service
provided by company engaged in the business of manufacturing garments
and other textile articles.

13. Printing, sewing or pasting  of logo, knitting, crocheting or embroidering
on ready made garments.

14. The colouring of cloth supplied by another person without changing the size
or shape of the said cloth.

15. The manufacture of batik fabrics using traditional techniques of manual block
printing, manual screen printing and/or hand drawing or painting and the
articles thereof.

16. A cleaning operation by removing dirt or dust without any further
operations.".

Made 29 August 2022
[KE.HF(152) 899/04 JLD 2(7); MOF.TAX(S)700-1/2/26 JLD. 5; PN(PU2)751/JLD. 7]
